newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Wednesday, with no deals heard, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 54.50-55.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.25-54.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
They said there were bids at 53.50 cents/lb fob Palembang and Padang, but sellers refused to lower their offer prices despite the slow demand.
Sellers prefered to stay on the sidelines and were seen holding firm to their offer prices until Friday, they said.
